name: Multi-Hit BVH Traversal
aliases: Multi-Hit BVH Traversal for Volume Clipping
Ray Traced Volume Clipping Using Multi-Hit BVH Traversal
definition: A technique to determine the N closest intersections of a viewing ray with compound clip objects (made of geometric primitives organized in a BVH) to construct clip intervals for volume rendering, avoiding dynamic memory reallocation by using a static array.
